exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. 1 Where is Anastasia? 2 Who is the little girl in the painting?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. 1 Anastasiya qayerda? 2 Rasmdagi kichkina qiz kim?
exercises.explanationUz:
SURAT: Anastasiya (Anya) qisqa
  soch, oddiy kiyimda - devordagi
  kichik qiz rasmiga qarab turibdi.

  1 U eski saroyda (Sankt-
    Peterburgdagi Romanovlar
    saroyida) - rasm galereyasida.
  2 Rasmdagi kichkina qiz - o'zi,
    Anastasiya bolaligida (malika
    kiyimida). U buni hali
    eslamaydi.


⚠ 'A PAINTING':

  = rasm (bo'yoq bilan chizilgan).


⚠ FILM HAQIDA:

  'Anastasia' (1997) - rus
  malikasi Anastasiya Romanova
  haqidagi multfilm. Inqilobda
  oilasi halok bo'ladi, u xotirasini
  yo'qotib bolalar uyida 'Anya'
  bo'lib o'sadi.

tasks.answer: She is in the old palace, looking at a painting on the wall.
tasks.speakAnswer: She is in the old palace, looking at a painting on the wall.

tasks.answer: Who is the little girl in the painting?
tasks.speakAnswer: Who is the little girl in the painting?

tasks.answer: The little girl in the painting is Anastasia herself when she was a child.
tasks.speakAnswer: The little girl in the painting is Anastasia herself when she was a child.

exercises.explanationUz:
FILM SYUJETI - 8 ta fakt.

  1 Tsar of RUSSIA - Rossiya
    podshosi Nikolay II
  2 AT A BALL - saroyda bazm
  3 A MUSIC BOX - musiqa qutisi
    (buvisi bergan)
  4 RASPUTIN - yovuz sehrgar
  5 the REVOLUTION - 1917 inqilob
  6 DIMITRI - saroy xizmatchisi
    bola, qochishga yordam bergan
  7 the ORPHANAGE - bolalar uyi
  8 POOKA - kuchuk, eng yaqin
    do'sti


⚠ 'TSAR':

  = podsho (rus).


⚠ 'EMPRESS':

  = imperator ayol / malika-ona.


⚠ 'REVIEW / REVISION / REVOLUTION':

  review = sharh; revision =
  takrorlash; revolution = inqilob.

exercises.instructionEn: Anastasia's life at the orphanage was very different to her life at the palace. Use the prompts to talk about her life, as in the examples. THEN: wear/beautiful clothes; eat/delicious food; own/expensive jewellery; have/loving family; live/huge, luxurious palace; meet/famous people. NOW: wear/ragged clothes; eat/plain soup; own/nothing; have/no one; live/small, cramped orphanage; meet/only other orphans.
exercises.instructionUz: Anastasiyaning bolalar uyidagi hayoti saroydagi hayotidan juda farq qilardi. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib uning hayoti haqida namunadagidek gapiring. ILGARI: chiroyli kiyim; mazali taom; qimmat taqinchoq; mehribon oila; ulkan hashamatli saroy; mashhur odamlar. HOZIR: yirtiq kiyim; oddiy sho'rva; hech narsa; hech kim; kichik, tor bolalar uyi; faqat boshqa yetimlar.
exercises.explanationUz:
USED TO (ilgari) va PRESENT SIMPLE
  (hozir) - 2-unit grammatikasi.

  Then she USED TO + fe'l.
  Now she + fe'l(s).

  ⚠ 'own nothing' = hech narsaga
  ega emas; 'have no one' = hech
  kimi yo'q.


⚠ 'RAGGED':

  = yirtiq, juldur.


⚠ 'CRAMPED':

  = tor, siqiq.


⚠ 'LUXURIOUS':

  = hashamatli.

tasks.en: Then she used to wear beautiful clothes. Now she wears ragged clothes.
tasks.uz: Ilgari u chiroyli kiyimlar kiyardi. Hozir u yirtiq kiyim kiyadi. (NAMUNA)

tasks.en: Then she used to eat delicious food. Now she eats plain soup.
tasks.uz: Ilgari u mazali taomlar yerdi. Hozir u oddiy sho'rva yeydi.

tasks.en: Then she used to own expensive jewellery. Now she owns nothing.
tasks.uz: Ilgari uning qimmat taqinchoqlari bor edi. Hozir uning hech narsasi yo'q.

tasks.en: Then she used to have a loving family. Now she has no one.
tasks.uz: Ilgari uning mehribon oilasi bor edi. Hozir uning hech kimi yo'q.

tasks.en: Then she used to live in a huge, luxurious palace. Now she lives in a small, cramped orphanage.
tasks.uz: Ilgari u ulkan, hashamatli saroyda yashardi. Hozir u kichik, tor bolalar uyida yashaydi.

tasks.en: Then she used to meet famous people. Now she meets only other orphans.
tasks.uz: Ilgari u mashhur odamlar bilan uchrashardi. Hozir u faqat boshqa yetimlar bilan uchrashadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Explain why the name 'Anastasia' is a suitable one.
exercises.instructionUz: Nima uchun 'Anastasiya' ismi mos ekanini tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
'ANASTASIA' ISMINING MA'NOSI.

  Yunoncha 'anastasis' = QAYTA
  TIRILISh, tiklanish. Filmda
  Anastasiya 'o'lgan' deb hisoblanadi,
  lekin u tirik chiqadi va o'z
  o'tmishini, oilasini (buvisini)
  qayta topadi - ya'ni 'qayta
  tiriladi'.


⚠ 'SUITABLE':

  = mos, munosib.

tasks.en: Why is the name 'Anastasia' a suitable one?

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the different forms of transport Anya, Dimitri and Vladimir use: plane, ship, horse, bus, train, lorry.
exercises.instructionUz: Anya, Dimitri va Vladimir foydalangan transport turlarini belgilang: samolyot, kema, ot, avtobus, poyezd, yuk mashinasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
FILMDAGI SAYOHAT: Sankt-
  Peterburg → Parij.

  ✓ TRAIN - poyezdda Rossiyadan
    chiqishadi (Rasputin poyezdni
    buzadi)
  ✓ SHIP - kemada Germaniyadan
    Fransiyaga (Rasputin bo'ron
    yuboradi)
  ✓ BUS - Parijda avtobus
  ✗ plane, horse, lorry - yo'q


⚠ 'A LORRY':

  = yuk mashinasi (BrE; AmE -
  truck).

exercises.instructionEn: Find the answer (unscramble the letters in brackets).
exercises.explanationUz:
ARALASh HARFLAR.

  1 RSPIA → PARIS - ular Parijga
    ketishyapti (buvisi o'sha
    yerda)
  2 LABLTE → BALLET - balet
    teatrida Dimitri imperatritsa
    bilan gaplashmoqchi bo'ladi
  3 ROTEEGHT → TOGETHER - marjonda
    'Together in Paris' (Parijda
    birga) yozilgan


⚠ 'A NECKLACE':

  = marjon, bo'yinga taqiladigan
  zeb-ziynat.

exercises.instructionEn: Write a sentence about what happens at the end of the story to: a) Rasputin b) Dimitri and Anastasia c) Bartok (the bat).
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya oxirida quyidagilarga nima bo'lishi haqida bittadan gap yozing: a) Rasputin b) Dimitri va Anastasiya c) Bartok (ko'rshapalak).
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM OXIRI.

  a) Rasputin - Anastasiya uning
     sehrli idishini sindiradi va
     u yo'q bo'lib ketadi (o'ladi).
  b) Dimitri va Anastasiya - bir-
     birini sevib qolishadi va
     birga ketishadi (Anastasiya
     malika hayotidan voz kechadi).
  c) Bartok - Rasputinning
     ko'rshapalagi ozod bo'ladi va
     boshqa ko'rshapalak bilan
     sevishib qoladi.


⚠ 'A BAT':

  = ko'rshapalak.

tasks.en: a) At the end of the story Anastasia breaks Rasputin's magic reliquary and he is destroyed.
tasks.uz: a) Hikoya oxirida Anastasiya Rasputinning sehrli idishini sindiradi va u yo'q bo'lib ketadi.

tasks.en: b) Dimitri and Anastasia fall in love and go away together to start a new life.
tasks.uz: b) Dimitri va Anastasiya bir-birini sevib qolishadi va yangi hayot boshlash uchun birga ketishadi.

tasks.en: c) Bartok, the bat, is free at last and finds a girlfriend bat.
tasks.uz: c) Ko'rshapalak Bartok nihoyat ozod bo'ladi va o'ziga ko'rshapalak qiz do'st topadi.

exercises.instructionEn: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Do you have a good relationship with your grandparents? Tell the class.
exercises.instructionUz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Buvi-buvangiz bilan munosabatingiz yaxshimi? Sinfga aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHOKAMA - Anastasiya va buvisi
  (Empress Maria) munosabati.

  Namuna javob:
  'Yes, I have a very good
  relationship with my
  grandparents. I visit them every
  weekend. My grandmother tells me
  stories about the past and my
  grandfather teaches me to play
  chess.'


⚠ 'A RELATIONSHIP':

  = munosabat.

tasks.en: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Do you have a good relationship with your grandparents? Tell the class.
tasks.uz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Buvi-buvangiz bilan munosabatingiz yaxshimi? Sinfga aytib bering.

tasks.en: Do you have a good relationship with your grandparents?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'Yes, I do. I visit my grandparents every weekend and my grandmother tells me stories about the past.' (Ha. Har dam olish kuni buvi-buvamnikiga boraman va buvim menga o'tmish haqida hikoyalar aytib beradi.)

sentencePatterns.formula: Then she used to + FE'L. Now she + FE'L(s).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Then she used to live in a huge palace. Now she lives in a small orphanage.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ilgari u ulkan saroyda yashardi. Hozir u kichik bolalar uyida yashaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: At the end of the story + KIM + FE'L (present simple)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: At the end of the story Dimitri and Anastasia fall in love.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hikoya oxirida Dimitri va Anastasiya sevishib qolishadi.
